title: Teenage fan dies after medical emergency before Stray Kids concert in Argentina

blocks.text: A 16-year-old girl died Monday, Sept. 14, after suffering a medical emergency shortly before entering Stray Kids’ concert during the “Straycity” festival at the San Isidro Racecourse near Buenos Aires, according to Argentine media reports. Emergency personnel at the venue treated the teenager before she was taken to San Isidro Central Hospital about 400 meters away. Doctors attempted to resuscitate her, but she was later pronounced dead after suffering cardiorespiratory arrest.
